comment: The reviewed input manifest of the CI combined lane (docs/ci-lanes.md). NOT deploy/testnet/pins.json (that is the testnet package's). scripts/ci/check-pins.sh verifies every built or downloaded component against this file and refuses a wrong pin.

ureth.note: ureth unicity/main at the merge of ureth#103 (b8a50547: VT-14 VR batch pins on #102, the VT-02 hook, and #101, VT-15: record kinds 6 to 8 and the SealRegistry pin 0xebbadc64, the runtime this bft-core genesis carries), which includes ureth#97: the protocol 6/7 bridge precompile 0x0105 removed, so engineapi/profile.go no longer requires it (bft-core#1139; a consensus change, a fresh network generation). Before: ureth vt15/lane-pin (7fdc5a32): the lane pin 10552af2 plus the VT-15 commit of ristik/ureth#101, kept off unicity/main while engineapi still required 0x0105. Before: ureth unicity/main at the merge of ureth#94 (10552af2: the snapshots of the resealed corpus) on ureth#93 (870c1d01, the native B1 precompile on the upstream seal rule, 7,200 gas per supplied seal signature, protocol 7, bft-core#920)
ureth.nativePrecompilesNote: the Unicity native precompiles this ureth registers beside the pinned Cancun set (name: address, as eth_config reports them). scripts/ci/lane-product.sh compat requires the product's engineapi/profile.go unicityNativePrecompiles to be exactly this set, for the checkout and the pinned product (each against its own ureth); build-ureth.sh checks each name is a precompile id of the source it builds. 0x0105 (unicity-bridge-compose-v2) is gone since ureth#97
ureth.targetedNote: the plan's targeted selectors (briefs/ci-lane-migration-plan.md section 1): any-age/batch/layout/provider vectors, system-hook ordering and gas, certified RPC/recovery, persistence. Not cargo test --workspace and no generic Ethereum suites.

bft-core.note: the frozen PoS release product SHA (deploy/testnet/evidence/release-manifest.md, arch plan section 10): enforced only when a run asks for product=pinned (a campaign run: dispatch input, or run-inputs.json on a ci-lane-run/** branch). Pull request, scheduled and default runs build the checkout under test and do not read this pin. In a pinned run ubft and the Go tools are built from a separate checkout of exactly this commit; the harness (scripts, workflow) stays the checkout's own. Its dependency set is dependencies below, not the components'

dependencies.note: the frozen product's own dependency set (deploy/testnet/evidence/release-manifest.md section 3, 2026-11-10): a product=pinned run builds and checks these commits instead of the components' (scripts/ci/lane-product.sh manifest). The product requires the protocol 6/7 bridge precompile 0x0105 and carries the pre-VT-15 SealRegistry, so it cannot run with the components' ureth (b8a50547, no 0x0105, bft-core#1139); moving the product pin is a release-process step, not a pin batch. The aggregator is paired with the product's root: the checkout's aggregator-go follows live shard configuration changes through the root's shard-aware POST /api/v1/q3/shard-conf (bft-core#1203), which the frozen product's root does not have, so the frozen product keeps the aggregator it was frozen with (and has no kind 6 or 8 change to follow). Components not named here (state-transition-sdk-js, the toolchains) are shared with the checkout product

contracts.note: contracts main at the merge of contracts#91 (4fd6b1a3: VT-14 VR genesis on #89 VT-02 hook fixtures, #88 VT-15 record kinds 6 to 8 in the SealRegistry, custody and RewardPool, #87 PoA election, #86/#84 VT-16 vectors, #85 the ValidatorRegistry, #83 the protocol 6/7 bridge removed, #81/#82 the NB2 vault and verifier; bft-core#1139). runner.label: ubuntu-24.04
runner.minFreeDiskNote: Measured on ubuntu-24.04 standard runners (4 CPU / 16 GB), runs 39391426570 and 39399607786: the lane's disk growth peaks at 3.88 GiB (the cold ureth build 3.79 GiB, the Go build 3.72 GiB, sources 0.97 GiB); memory peaks at 2.36 GiB (run) and 4.62 GiB (ureth build), no swap. The gate is checked by the preflight after the inputs are unpacked: 8 GiB is 2.06 times the measured peak growth, so a run twice as chatty as the measured one still fits, and it is far below the 25 GiB of the Mac default (which also covers building ureth and contracts there). A runner with less than 8 GiB free after unpacking is refused, never waved through.
runner.minFreeDiskUrethTargetedNote: Measured (run 39433678003, ubuntu-24.04 standard runner): the targeted ureth test build and run grow the disk by 11.15 GiB and use 8.21 GiB of memory (304 tests, 11.3 min sampled). The gate is 24 GiB: 2.15 times the growth, checked by scripts/ci/test-ureth.sh before it builds.

lane.note: the aggregator partition runs as two bft-shard aggregators (0x40, 0xc0); the UTB steps verify the aggregator's certificates under every shard's configuration. The protocol 6/7 bridge steps (the any-age L1 token over both shards, the consolidated and the long-history redemptions) and the native-bridge-plugins pin were removed with that bridge (bft-core#1106)
lane.evmT2Note: the EVM shard's T2 in the CI lane (milliseconds; the Mac default stays 5000). After the recovery only 3 of the 4 enrolled validators run, so a round needs all three signatures and its latency is the slowest of three: measured first-UC-to-third-signature up to 14.3 s on a standard runner (bft-core#728, run 39554461091), while T2 = 5 s turned every late round into a permanent livelock. 15 s passed the combined lane with all steps; the margin over the measured tail is small, see #728.

t6.comment: T6 pins its own inputs in scripts/t6-rehearsal.sh (its defaults); they differ from the lane's on purpose and are not unified silently. check-pins.sh t6 refuses a script whose defaults differ from this record.
